test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If Cos A = {{9} over 41}, find cot A.
solution:
Given:

Cos A = 9/41 

Formula used:

 cot A = cos A/sin A

Cos² A + sin² A = 1

Calculation:

Cos2 A + sin2 A = 1

⇒ ( 9/41)² + sin2 A = 1

⇒ sin2 A = 1 - 81/1681

 ⇒ sin2 A = 1600/1681

⇒ sin A = 40/41

⇒ cot A = cos A/sin A

 ⇒ cot A = 9/40

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
